# Optional App Store "What's New" override. Keep this file comment-only between
# releases so dist/app-store-release-notes.sh derives notes from commits.
#
# To override one release, add `# Release version: x.y.z` and the user-facing
# text below it. The script rejects missing or stale version markers before any
# store upload.
# Release version: 0.2.29

• Create your own space from + → Create (or "Create a space" when you have none). You own it: set up channels, roles and emoji, then invite friends.
• Being made a server administrator now takes effect after restarting Daccord, without signing out.
• New guide: Becoming an Admin explains space ownership and how to set up your server's administrator account.
